messages:
Alex Kim: Hey - CI is red for the integration suite hitting Hosted API. Failures concentrated in auth + streaming + tool-calls on shards 14 & 21. 401s and `RST_STREAM` during streaming.
Miriam Singh: repro'ed locally against `staging-hosted` with `make integ RUN_SHARDS=14`. See snippet below.
Miriam Singh: ```
E 03:12:15 auth: token validation failed: jwks: no matching kid
E 03:12:15 stream: rpc error: code = Unauthenticated desc = invalid token
```
Sam Liu: that sounds like the kid rotation change I landed in #4021 yesterday. cc @Priya Rao
Priya Rao: yep, I pushed a tiny jwks caching tweak. rolling back to test...
Jen Ortiz: can infra trigger a targeted rerun for the failing shards? /rerun ci shards=14,21
InfraBot: Rerun requested: job 12901 for shards [14,21]. ETA ~3m
ci-bot: job 12901 finished: shard-14 green, shard-21 still failing (401)
Alex Kim: interesting — shard-21 is consistently failing. stack traces show the kid mismatch.
Miriam Singh: I bisected locally: passing at commit abc123, failing at def456 (PR #4021). Looks like the header normalization change altered kid lookup.
Priya Rao: pushing a quick patch to revert the normalization, will open 4023. Can someone run smoke against hosted after deploy?
Jen Ortiz: assigning to eng-infra to do a smoke; @Sam Liu can you coordinate post-deploy quick run?
Sam Liu: yep, will watch. If smoke passes we'll re-run full integration.
Alex Kim: thanks all. tagging this as P2 but keep it timeboxed. I'll post update here when PR merged.
Priya Rao: PR 4023 opened: small revert. link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4023
InfraBot: Deploy of infra@def789 started to staging-hosted
ci-bot: smoke job 12910 passed. scheduling full rerun for shards 21
ci-bot: rerun job 12911 finished: all shards green. closing thread :tada:
Jen Ortiz: awesome, thanks everyone :shipit:
